title: Cluj Napoca nip Oradea to defend Liga Nationala title
description: FINALOradea - Cluj Napoca 67-68 Cluj Napoca earned the fifth straight Liga Nationala title. They overcame Oradea in the decisive fifth game of the chamionship series to repeat as champions. The guests trailed by 2 points after three quarters before their 19-16 charge, which allowed them to win the game. The best player for the winners was American point guard Zavier Simpson (183-1997, college: Michigan) who scored 26 points. His fellow American import center Zachary Hankins (211-1996, college: Xavier, agency: Octagon Europe) chipped in 8 points and 8 rebounds. Cluj Napoca's coach Mihai Silvasan used a ten-player rotation in such tough game. Lithuanian Donatas Tarolis (205-1994) produced a double-double by scoring 18 points, 12 rebounds, 4 assists and 4 steals and American-Cambodian guard Sayeed Pridgett (196-1998, college: Montana, agency: Diamond Sports) added 12 points and 6 rebounds…
